newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil CPFL begun as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil CPFL begun as hold.

text.p: HSBC James Capel said it has initiated coverage of Brazilian power utility CPFL with a hold rating.

-- It said in a report CPFL's short-term prospects are priced into cashflow multiples, adding that it sees limited upside in the short run and recommends "investors take no more than a neutral weighting in the shares."
-- CPFL is expected to be privatized late 1997.
-- HSBC James Capel also said any delay in the privatization to 1998 could depress the share price.
-- CPFL shares have not been traded so far today on the Sao Paulo bourse.
